thread:
ana_cs: Planning note: Reticle account go-live dry run scheduled Tue 2026-04-07 09:30 PT. Objective: validate quota enforcement, autoscale policy, and a targeted 20m stress window. Who can drive infra?
devin_infra: I can. Contracted reserved GPUs: 6xH100 reserved, customer allowed burst to 10. Need clarifying on burst billing and priority lanes.
ana_cs: (typo) ana_cs: billing cliff is documented in the SLA addendum. For operations, they want burst to be automatic but bill at burst rates and ship alerts to their SRE.
kai_sre: Proposed autoscale knobs: min=2, target_gpu_util=0.65, max=10, burst_cooldown=240s. Also suggest request-level tagging so we can attribute cost back to account_id=reticle-prod.
devin_infra: I'll prepare a terraform plan and an infra PR. Loadtest plan: 3-phase — canary 5m (10 RPS), ramp 10m to 400 RPS, sustain 5m, then spike 2m @ 600 RPS. We'll simulate token-heavy chat flows.
sam_oncall: I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and model error rate. Happy to take pager if anything crosses p99 errors >1%. Ping me 7m prior.
ana_cs: please include KV/cache priming run; customer flows include long multi-turn chats so warm KV is critical. Also capture token costs and per-route cost tags.
kai_sre: Adding a pre-load pass: run 100 sessions to warm prefix cache and seed common completions. We'll also enable prefix_cache=true on the model route.
devin_infra: Loadscript location: s3://redwood-loads/reticle/2026-04-06/reticle-load-v1.tar.gz. Sample command: `k6 run --vus 450 --duration 22m util_scenario.js` (this will overshoot in highest phase).
nana_cs: Safety guard: if reserved pool consumption > 88% for 6m, flip new traffic to hosted-fallback cluster and trigger incident lane. Also auto-scale backoff if queue depth >500.
capacity_bot: Note: quota-monitor rule 'reserved-pool-high' created by @kai_sre. Alert channel: #ops-oncall and #customer-success-reticle. Link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/qp-8892
sam_oncall: I'll draft the watch checklist: metrics to monitor: avg_gpu_util, cpu_wait, queue_depth, p50/p95 latency, token_cost_per_1000, model_errors. Will post 15m before window.
devin_infra: Draft autoscale config (will go in infra PR):
```
min_instances: 2
max_instances: 10
scale_metric: avg_gpu_usage
target: 0.65
cooldown_seconds: 240
burst_policy: auto
```
PR: https://git.internal/infra/reticle-autoscale/pull/78 (assigning @kai_sre)
kai_sre: LGTM. I'll add tracing headers and a temporary debug endpoint to sample kv hit-rate. Also wire an eval run: quick prompt set to compare latencies between reserved and hosted fallback.
nana_cs: Customer enablement: I'll run a 30m prep call tomorrow to walk their SRE through throttles and fallback behavior. I'll also include the renewal team if we hit steady utilization >75% for 3 days post-run.
sam_oncall: Fallback plan: route to hosted-model (stable v2.0) on threshold breach; degrade features (no streaming) to preserve SLOs. Also temp quota bump process documented in runbook 'capacity-bump-proc'.
devin_infra: Scheduling note: PR merge required by EOD Mon 2026-04-06 to allow config rollouts. Will tag @ana_cs when merged.
kai_sre: One more ask — capture per-token billing labels and export to metrics store so finance can reconcile post-test.
nana_cs: Great. I'll send an invite to Reticle for 09:15 PT to sync and confirm they won't run parallel smoke tests. Thanks team.
